gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ysabeau: Rope-thick curves and a stencil-cut feel give Balsamiq Sans a loud, hand-made look, while Ysabeau sweeps along below in open curves. Its loudness meets a plain sans that stays out of the way.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ysabeau-office: Tube-like strokes of constant width make Balsamiq Sans feel bold and bendy, with no pinched corners anywhere. Ysabeau Office, a plain sans, keeps its curves open beneath.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC opens with a visibly gaping c, a plain sans that lets light into every word. And Balsamiq Sans, with its monoline stroke from start to finish, would carry that openness down a long page without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans reads friendly and unfussy, with curved letters left open at the ends. And Balsamiq Sans, glowing like neon glass tubing above it, lets the body text be sized up a notch for comfort.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zalando-sans-exp: Zalando Sans Expanded reads wide and sparing, its c tips held well apart and its letters given generous gaps. And Balsamiq Sans brings a stroke with no hairlines to squint at, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Expressive from the first word, Balsamiq Sans is stencil-cut and flat. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded answers with open-mouthed curves on c, e, and s, and that flat, single-weight stroke against the sans's easy curves is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans draws its monoline letters with one constant stroke and no pinched turns. ZCOOL XiaoWei, a sans-serif, adds gentle thick-thin shifts below, so the page gets variety without fuss.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-: Modern and tidy, Zen Kaku Gothic Antique keeps its t crossbar and stem at matching weight, with smooth paths around each bend. And Balsamiq Sans adds a bold, stencil-cut voice, which is the pair's strongest quality.
